import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/data/worldbank_education_gdp.csv')

# Filter rows for relevant indicators
relevant_series_names = [
    'Labor force participation rate, total (percentage of total population ages 15+) (modeled ILO estimate)',
    'School enrollment, primary (percentage gross)',
    'School enrollment, secondary (percentage gross)',
    'Exports of goods and services (annual percentage growth)'
]

# Filter the dataset to include only the relevant rows
df_relevant = df[df['Series Name'].isin(relevant_series_names)]

# Melt the dataset to have each year as a row
df_melted = df_relevant.melt(id_vars=['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Series Name'], 
                             var_name='Year', 
                             value_name='Value')

# Convert the 'Year' column to numeric
df_melted['Year'] = df_melted['Year'].str.extract(r'(\d{4})').astype(int)

# Filter the data to include only the years from 1975 to 2015
df_filtered = df_melted[(df_melted['Year'] >= 1975) & (df_melted['Year'] <= 2015)]

# Group the data by 'Country Group', 'Country Code', and 'Year' to calculate the mean values
df_grouped = df_filtered.groupby(['Country Group', 'Country Code', 'Year', 'Series Name'])['Value'].mean().reset_index()

# Display the first few rows of the grouped dataset
df_grouped.head()
